plain: A mixed-up mass; a pooling of different things into one.

webster.text: Properly, a mingled mass; a mixture of ingredients.

more.text: In law, a mixing of lands.

example.quote: If we are to be considered as a nation, all State distinctions must be abolished, the whole must be thrown into hotchpot, and when an equal division is made, then there may be fairly an equality of representation.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 9, 1787
